verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair axis for a finance and spend-management platform, but the evidence documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Jeeves itself. The MCP server lets external AI assistants query spend "without opening the Jeeves app," which is an external-agent capability, not in-product insights. Smart invoice scanning and automated missing-receipt emails are adjacent automation features, not AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
